content: Let $$\alpha x+\beta y+\gamma z=1$$ be the equation of a plane passing through the point $$(3,-2,5)$$ and perpendicular to the line joining the points $$(1,2,3)$$ and $$(-2,3,5)$$. Then the value of $$\alpha \beta y$$ is equal to _____________.
